label: Freeform net
tooltip: Lay a quad net over the scan, automatically or by hand row by row; the deviation shows live as colour.
help: For roundings and organic shapes. Auto net lays the net over the scan or the selection in one step; by hand it grows face by face: place a face, then drag border edges. The status bar tells what the mouse does right now. OK creates B-spline faces, a body when the net is closed.

face.label: Face
face.description: Click four corners on the scan, one after another.

all.label: Snap to scan
all.description: Lay the whole net onto the scan.

chosen.label: Snap chosen
chosen.description: Lay only the chosen points onto the scan.

all.label: Smooth
all.description: Calm the whole net; it stays close to the scan.

flatten.label: Lay on a plane
flatten.description: Lay the chosen points (at least 3) on their best-fit plane.

snap.label: Snap to scan
snap.description: Dragged points and new rows land on the scan.

rectangle.label: Rectangle
rectangle.description: Click two opposite corners on the scan.

pin.label: Pin
pin.description: The chosen points stay where they are when dragging, snapping and smoothing.

unpin.label: Release
unpin.description: The chosen pinned points can move again.

neighbours.label: Don't move neighbours
neighbours.description: A dragged point bends the surface only up to its neighbouring points; they stay.

strength.label: Drag strength
strength.description: Dragged points follow the mouse only by this share, for fine adjustments.

legend: Green: within tolerance · Yellow to red: outside the scan · Blue: inside · Grey: far away
irregularHint: Red points: face borders start here. Fewer of them give larger CAD faces.

hints.start: Click the first corner on the scan
hints.face: Click corner {{count}} of 4 · Backspace: back · Esc: cancel
hints.point: Drag: move · onto a border point: join · Alt: along the normal · Delete: remove
hints.border: Drag: move the edge · drag the D grip or with Alt: new row · Double click: whole side · Right click: menu
hints.edge: Click: choose · Double click: edge chain · Drag: move · S: split · Right click: menu
hints.rows: Release: add the row · yellow points get joined · Esc: cancel
hints.idle: Drag an edge's D grip: extend the net · Drag a point: shape · Right click: menu · Space: surface only
hints.corner: Click the opposite corner · Backspace: back · Esc: cancel
hints.empty: Choose Face or Rectangle (in the panel or by right click), then click on the scan
hints.handle: Drag: duplicate the edge into a new row on the scan · drop onto border points: join
hints.pinned: Pinned: dragging, snapping and smoothing leave it in place · Click, then right click: release

menu.snapAll: Snap all points to the scan
menu.snapChosen: Snap chosen points to the scan
